title: Beneath the Paris Sky
content:
The room remained silent after Yashwanth finished telling his story.

Neither of them spoke for several long moments.

Siddu quietly looked at his friend before finally breaking the silence.

"Did you tell your father about Varsha?"

Yashwanth slowly lowered his head.

"No..."

The single word carried more regret than any explanation ever could.

Siddu let out a gentle sigh.

"Yash..."

"If you hide the truth today..."

"The pain will only grow tomorrow."

"He is your father."

"Trust him."

"Sometimes..."

"Parents understand us more than we think."

Yashwanth remained silent.

His mind was filled with endless questions.

What if he refuses?

What if I disappoint him?

What if I lose everyone?

The fear inside him refused to fade.

Seeing his friend sink deeper into his thoughts, Siddu gently placed a reassuring hand on his shoulder.

"Don't overthink it."

Yashwanth slowly looked up.

A calm smile rested on Siddu's face.

"I'll come with you."

"You won't have to face this alone."

For a moment...

Yashwanth simply stared at him.

The burden on his heart suddenly felt a little lighter.

Unable to hold back his emotions any longer, he stepped forward and embraced Siddu tightly.

"Thank you..."

"Thank you for always standing beside me."

Siddu smiled and hugged him back.

"That's what friends are for."

For a few silent moments...

Neither of them spoke.

Some friendships never needed words.

Yashwanth slowly stepped back and nodded.

"We'll go tomorrow."

"And I'll tell my father everything."

For the first time in days...

A small spark of hope returned to his eyes.

________________________________________

Meanwhile...

Nearly six thousand kilometers away...

Paris welcomed another peaceful evening.

After returning from the café, Yagnesh lay on his bed, staring at the ceiling.

No matter how hard he tried...

He couldn't stop thinking about Shreya.

Her smile...

Her laughter...

The way she passionately spoke about anime...

And the quiet kindness hidden behind her eyes.

"What is happening to me...?"

he whispered to himself.

Unable to stay inside any longer, he decided to go out for a walk.

As the sun disappeared beyond the horizon, Paris transformed into a city of shimmering lights.

Without giving it much thought, he booked a cab.

"To the Eiffel Tower."

A short while later...

The cab came to a stop.

Yagnesh stepped out and instinctively looked up.

The Eiffel Tower stood proudly against the night sky.

Thousands of golden lights sparkled across its magnificent iron structure, making it look almost magical beneath the moonlight.

People from every corner of the world filled the open square.

Some captured photographs.

Some laughed with friends and family.

Others simply stood in silence, admiring the breathtaking beauty before them.

A cool breeze brushed gently across Yagnesh's face.

He closed his eyes for a brief moment and took a deep breath.

"So this is Paris at night..."

A peaceful smile appeared on his face.

He slowly walked forward, enjoying every beautiful sight around him.

Just then...

He felt someone gently tap his shoulder from behind.

Curious, he turned around.

The moment he did...

He froze.

Standing beneath the shimmering lights of the Eiffel Tower...

With the cool breeze softly playing with her hair...

And the moon shining brightly above...

Was Shreya.

She smiled warmly.

"What a coincidence..."

"We keep meeting each other."

For a brief moment...

Yagnesh forgot where he was.

The lights of Paris...

The cheerful crowd...

Even the magnificent Eiffel Tower...

Everything around him slowly faded away.

At that moment...

The most beautiful sight in all of Paris...

Wasn't the tower.

It was the smiling woman standing right in front of him.
